svg.text: L20 crouch-then-jump (descriptive): DNg flexor volley -> DNp01-04 volley, lit5x taus
A two-phase DEL=60 (3 seeds, mean) — pools and theta = ext − flex
B controls — crouch-only (pure trough) vs stroke-only (pure swing), theta
C stroke recovery vs crouch-stroke delay DEL (peak theta; biphasic?)
flexor tau 255 ms swallows the stroke at DEL=30 — cannot jump mid-crouch
